repository_role: read-only view of the separately selected local Prime repository, not a new Prime Git history

implemented_scope.repository_selection: path label only; no enumeration or implicit metadata access
implemented_scope.snapshot_import: explicitly selected local JSON, at most 1 MiB, held regular-file read with before/after vnode and metadata joins
implemented_scope.data_semantics: reported local observation; schema validation is not independent Git graph recomputation or live verification
implemented_scope.unknown: absent values remain unobserved, never zero or clean
implemented_scope.remote_semantics: locally cached tracking refs only; no current GitHub claim
implemented_scope.persistence: import stays in memory; no bookmark, journal, or repository write
implemented_scope.action_buttons: visible and inert; no execution closure

future_read_only_adapter_requirements: Explicit user read grants for the selected worktree and any separate gitdir/commondir; no automatic traversal outside the grant
Capture start/end and HEAD, index, and tracking-ref identities; concurrent change is a stale display, not an execution failure or authority
Return unknown when upstream, cached ref, objects, or complete ancestry are unavailable
Suppress optional Git writes, config-driven helpers/hooks/fsmonitor, credential actions, pagers and lazy fetching before introducing a Git subprocess
Local refresh never means fetch; push, pull, commit, stage, checkout, merge and reset remain separate future actions

environment_test.requested: non-VM unit tests entered through env -i with no replacement variables
environment_test.meaning: empty launch-environment compatibility of that test process only

unchanged: original Prime checkout and Git history
